problem_type: Localized outcome copy introduces billing language unsupported by observable request state
symptom: noChargeClaims fails on English network hint; full-walk dictionary checks fail on Chinese pre-confirmation no-charge promise and ambiguous English free-composition rationale.
direct_cause: Actual UI locale values mention provider charging or imply no charge; a separate English rationale uses free to mean unconstrained composition, which is ambiguous to the financial wording invariant.
class_root: Failure/confirmation UI must describe known request state and next steps without inferring financial outcomes; creative-composition wording must be unambiguous and remain display-only.
affected_population: English display of canonical text-to-image rationale
internal_only_reason: This is localized product wording tied to existing request-state facts and source/display ownership. No provider billing fact or external service semantics are assumed.
invariants: Do not change billing, confirmation, authorization, retry, frozen source defaults or request routing
Do not weaken noChargeClaims/outcomeText detectors or their exemptions
Keep locale keys, interpolation order and the existing request/next-step facts
Change only one reviewed fixture Chinese value and retain all original fixture/binding/class hash constants, 475 keys/37 files/111 bindings and original 21 approved action-label changes
Canonical rationale and user prompt data remain unchanged when switching language

door_reduction.why_not: Localized resource exports and their real consumers remain distinct by language/namespace. Keep the existing i18n owner and fix only actual display copy.

generality_proof: Unmodified guards check the complete real dictionaries. New bilingual regression executes the actual i18n singleton, network narrator and canonical display adapter and compares frozen raw rationale/prompt JSON. The display Node guard explicitly restores this one reviewed old value before checking its unchanged full fixture hash.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Localized network narration without a financial inference
Shared pre-confirmation display key without a no-charge promise
Display-only English creative rationale with unambiguous composition wording

same_class_entry_points.evidence: The existing UI still displays wave/concurrency and confirmation behavior; only its locale string changes.
The real narrator reads the edited English network hint, retaining error reason and network/proxy next steps.
Known canonical rationale is translated only at display boundary; sourceDefaults and stored values are untouched.

recurrence.reason: Any locale or render path can turn a request-state message into an unverified financial claim; source/display mixing can also rewrite raw user data.
same_class_scan: Generated i18n resource export consumer doors
Ran both unchanged original dictionary guards and identified exact offending keys
Read BatchPlanOverlay and the actual narrator/display adapter
Read strict display fixture counts/hash restoration; one exact reviewed copy delta only

prevention.invariant: Shared locale owners express truthful state without billing promises and retain data identity.
prevention.failure_mode: Existing whole-dictionary guards still reject financial claims; exact fixture guard rejects any additional unreviewed string/binding/layout changes.
prevention.strategy: Correct actual locale values, preserve all billing logic/detectors, and add precise bilingual source/display and fixture-delta evidence.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replace billing-implicating outcome text and ambiguous English creative wording in the actual resource owners; do not touch unused legacy production locale fragments.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Reuse existing i18next and display/narration APIs. No dependency change is required for copy truthfulness.

migration: No data migration. Locale key IDs and canonical rationale source values remain unchanged; only display strings and one exact fixture value change.
residual_risks: No actual App/Provider billing acceptance is run or claimed
English free composition is recorded as semantic ambiguity rather than a billing promise; wording is clarified without changing detection

The unchanged door-map tool lists resource consumers rather than standalone export definitions, leaving two door-coverage advisories for generationCommon.ts and customWorkflow.ts. Actual generated doors and real locale owner boundaries are retained without fabricated entries or checker changes.
